patient.living_situation: Shares a flat with two housemates
patient.employment_status: Self-employed graphic designer with irregular income
patient.social_context: Much of her social life centers on bars and events; close to her sister
patient.background: Fictional graphic designer who shares a flat and has an active social life.
patient.history_summary: Heavy drinking at weekends since university, with occasional memory gaps and one driving incident in 2024.
patient.treatment_summary: One brief advice session at a campus clinic (2018). No specialist treatment since.

history_events.description: Starts regular weekend drinking in her first term at university.
Attends a single brief advice session at the campus clinic.
Graduates and starts freelance work; weekend drinking continues.
Has a first memory gap after a night of heavy drinking.
Receives an official warning after a driving incident.

factors.description: Celebrations and nights out with friends.
Family history of alcohol problems: unknown.
Her sister checks in regularly and does not drink heavily.
Drinks faster than friends on nights out.
Often loses the following Monday to recovering from weekend drinking.

interventions.reported_outcome: Drank less for about two months, then returned to her earlier pattern.

progress.note: Unsure whether she wants to change; no goal set.
Reports two weekends without drinking; says this was because of travel.
Has set a personal goal to limit weekend drinking; has not contacted any service.
